user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Full Board Lifecycle - Create with List, then Create and Delete
proposed_scenarios.description: This end-to-end scenario validates the complete lifecycle of boards. It starts by creating a board, adding a list to it, and verifying its creation. It then proceeds to create a second board and immediately delete it, verifying its removal. This covers the core CRUD (Create, Read, Delete) operations for the Boards feature based on the agent's successful execution path.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that users can create boards, add content to them, and successfully delete them from the project to maintain their workspace.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a Project Manager, I want to create boards to organize tasks, add lists to those boards, and delete boards that are no longer needed, so that I can maintain an organized and up-to-date project workspace.

detailed_steps.description: Load the project's main dashboard page.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The project dashboard page is loaded successfully.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Ensures the primary entry point for the project is accessible.

detailed_steps.description: Navigate to the Boards section from the project's side navigation menu.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page URL changes to the boards list view.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Verifies that users can access the core Boards feature.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Create new board' button to initiate the board creation workflow.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page navigates to the new board creation form.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Starts the primary workflow for creating a new organizational board.

detailed_steps.description: Enter the name 'Automated board 1234' into the title field for the new board.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The title field is populated with the specified board name.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Defines the identity of the new board.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Create' button to finalize the creation of the new board.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page navigates to the newly created board's view, URL contains '/boards/'.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Add list to board' placeholder to create a new list within the board.
detailed_steps.verification_point: An input field appears to name the new list.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows users to add organizational columns (lists) to their board.

detailed_steps.description: Enter the name 'Automated List <rand4>' for the new list and press Enter to save it. A specific selector was not captured for this dynamic element, but the action is critical to the flow.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The new list with the specified name is created and visible on the board.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Completes the process of adding a new list to the board.
detailed_steps.selector: NOT_CAPTURED: Input field for new list name

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Boards' breadcrumb link to navigate back to the main boards list.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page returns to the main boards list view.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows user to return to the main overview page.

detailed_steps.description: Verify that the newly created board 'Automated board 1234' is present in the list of boards.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The page content includes the text 'Automated board 1234'.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Confirms the successful creation and persistence of the new board.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Create new board' button again to create a second board for the deletion test.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page navigates to the new board creation form.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Initiates the creation of a temporary board for deletion testing.

detailed_steps.description: Enter the name 'Automated board for deletion' into the title field.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The title field is populated with the specified board name.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Names the board that will be deleted.

detailed_steps.description: Click the 'Create' button to finalize the creation of the second board.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page navigates to the newly created board's view.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Completes the setup for the deletion test.

detailed_steps.description: Return to the main boards list page to perform the deletion.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page returns to the main boards list view.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Navigates to the location where the delete action can be performed.

detailed_steps.description: Locate the board named 'Automated board for deletion' and click its delete icon.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The board is removed from the list after the action.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Tests the critical delete functionality for boards.

detailed_steps.description: Verify that the board 'Automated board for deletion' is no longer visible on the boards list page.
detailed_steps.verification_point: The page content no longer includes the text 'Automated board for deletion'.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Confirms the successful deletion of the board, ensuring users can clean up their workspace.

expected_results: User successfully creates a board and adds a list to it.
The first created board is visible on the main boards page.
User successfully creates a second board.
User successfully deletes the second board.
The second board is no longer visible on the main boards page.
edge_cases_to_test: Attempting to create a board with a name that already exists.
Attempting to delete a board with active work packages.
Network interruption during board creation or deletion.
User permissions restricting board creation or deletion.
data_requirements: A valid user account with permissions to create and delete boards in the 'demo-project'.
prerequisites: The OpenProject instance at zbio.openproject.com is accessible.
The 'demo-project' exists and is accessible to the test user.
The user is authenticated before starting the scenario.
